title: CSL portable run statistics v4
description: Closed structural schema. The checked codec additionally enforces uint64/int64 range, finite values, UTF-8 byte limits, recomputed identities, content digests, subjects, clocks, DAGs, capacities and aggregate consistency.

directions.description: Oriented control-space directions requested for minimization.

batch.description: Raw observations are retained. returned_count is witnesses length; distinct_count uses ordered greedy representatives, matching states/control shapes, and maximum absolute difference over full joint histories <= distinctness_tolerance. This relation is nontransitive and its representative count is order dependent.
